title: PacQ: A SIMT Microarchitecture for Efficient Dataflow in Hyper-asymmetric GEMMs
problem: Weight-only quantization for LLMs stores weights in low-precision INT format while activations remain full-precision FP. During execution on SIMT architectures, weights must be unpacked and dequantized back to FP before GEMM, negating compute efficiency gains.
motivation: LLM deployment on SIMT architectures requires efficient handling of mixed INT-weight, FP-activation GEMMs; conventional architectures cannot efficiently compute such asymmetric operations.
method: PacQ co-optimizes INT weight packing and dataflow strategies at tile-level, then designs a specialized FP-INT multiplier unit enabling parallel processing of multiple INT weights. The microarchitecture integrates packing, optimized dataflow, and custom multiplier into a SIMT design.
key_novelty: Specialized FP-INT multiplier unit co-designed with tile-level packing and dataflow strategies to directly process packed low-precision weights without unpacking overhead.
contributions: Tile-level packing strategy optimized for INT weight matrices
Custom FP-INT multiplier unit for parallel INT weight processing
1.99x speedup and 81.4% EDP reduction on LLM workloads
baselines: conventional SIMT baselines with weight-only quantization
primary_theme: SIMT microarchitecture for weight-quantized LLM GEMMs with custom FP-INT multiplier
